company.name: Omooma
company.shortDescription: Omooma is a online motherhood training platform, led by experts, and empowering women with the knowledge they need to grow healthy families.
company.description: Omooma is an online motherhood training platform that provides maternity health courses and blogs delivered by healthcare professionals. Omooma covers a wide range of topics, including pregnancy, menstruation, postpartum depression, and menopause. Omooma's educational content provides women with the knowledge and information they need to succeed as mothers from the comfort and privacy of their own homes.
